title: 34 Birch House, Red Arches Park, Baldoyle, Dublin 13
seoTitle: 34 Birch House, Red Arches Park, Baldoyle, Dublin 13
description:
SMART Property are delighted to present No. 34 Birch House, an exceptional top-floor penthouse apartment offering luxurious three-bedroom accommodation in one of Dublin's most sought-after residential developments. Available to rent at 3,300 per month, this outstanding home combines contemporary design, premium finishes, exceptional energy efficiency, and generous outdoor space, making it an ideal choice for those seeking modern apartment living.

Constructed circa 2018, this impressive residence boasts an A2 BER rating, ensuring outstanding energy efficiency, lower utility costs, and year-round comfort. Positioned on the top floor, the apartment enjoys an abundance of natural light, enhanced privacy, elevated views, and impressive high ceilings throughout, creating a bright, spacious, and sophisticated living environment.

Upon entering, you are welcomed by a wide and inviting entrance hallway, finished with stylish grey wood-effect laminate flooring that flows seamlessly throughout the principal living accommodation. The generous proportions immediately create a wonderful sense of space while providing access to each room of the apartment.

The accommodation comprises three exceptionally spacious double bedrooms, all thoughtfully designed with comfort and practicality in mind. Two of the bedrooms are positioned to the front of the property, each featuring fitted wardrobes and direct access to the first private balcony, providing an ideal outdoor space to enjoy morning sunshine or relax outdoors.

The impressive principal bedroom is located to the rear of the apartment, offering a peaceful retreat complete with fitted wardrobes, a contemporary en-suite bathroom, and direct access to the apartment's second large west-facing private balcony. This generous outdoor space enjoys excellent afternoon and evening sunlight, making it perfect for outdoor dining, entertaining guests, or simply unwinding at the end of the day.

A notable feature rarely found in apartment living is the substantial walk-in storage room, fitted with double built-in storage wardrobes, providing exceptional storage capacity for household items, luggage, and seasonal belongings.
The main family bathroom is finished to an excellent standard and incorporates a full-sized bath with overhead shower, contemporary sanitary ware, and a large skylight which fills the room with natural daylight, creating a bright and welcoming space.

At the heart of the apartment lies the stunning open-plan kitchen, dining, and living area. Designed with modern lifestyles in mind, this expansive space is flooded with natural light through large glazed doors that open directly onto the second west-facing balcony, effortlessly blending indoor and outdoor living. The contemporary fitted kitchen offers ample storage and workspace, while the generous living and dining areas provide the perfect setting for both everyday living and entertaining.

Throughout the apartment, the combination of high ceilings, excellent proportions, quality finishes, and dual balconies creates an exceptional sense of space and luxury that is seldom found in apartment accommodation.
Further enhancing the appeal of this outstanding penthouse are its A2 energy rating, modern construction, quality insulation, and highly efficient heating systems, ensuring economical day-to-day living while maintaining excellent comfort levels throughout the year.

This exceptional penthouse apartment is offered partly furnished and is available immediately.

Viewing
Properties of this calibre and specification rarely remain available for long. With its penthouse position, A2 BER rating, two private balconies, spacious accommodation, and superb presentation, we anticipate a high level of interest.
Early applications are therefore strongly recommended.

To register your interest or arrange a viewing, please contact the SMART Property office by email today.
